rule_ids.value: Split the month by calendar days. Days before the change use the old ceiling. Days from the change use the new ceiling. Each segment is pro-rated by days.

rule_ids.source: AMB-02
rule_ids.value: PF wage for a month = Basic + DA earned after LOP (monthly amount × paid days ÷ days in month).

rule_ids.source: AMB-02
rule_ids.value: Monthly LOP has no dates, so it is spread evenly across the month. When a month is split into dated segments (for example, the PF ceiling change on 17 September, or a mid-month hike), each segment's earned PF wage = the month's earned PF wage × segment calendar days ÷ month calendar days. The ceiling is applied per segment, pro-rated by calendar days.
